title: [2.8.2.2-Dev] Unable to delete IOB
symptom: After giving a treatment, when going to the treatments option, the 'Remove' link does not appear to be able to remove the active insulin. The link is active to remove carbs.
cause: IOB translation in the user's language is too long, causing the remove link not to appear.
fix: Change the IOB translation in Crowdin. The feature can be tested in English language.
evidence_quote: IOB translation in your language is too long. Change it in Crowdin You may test the feature in English language
